# Ya Rahman Biriyani

> One family recipe, layered by hand, sealed with dough and slow-cooked on the dum, now in 15 kitchens across Chennai.

Website: https://yarahmanbriyani.com/

## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Ya Rahman Biriyani?
1A, Jeyachandran Nagar, Mambakkam Main Road, Medavakkam, Chennai.

### What facilities does Ya Rahman Biriyani have?
Hyderabadi dum biriyani, Bucket biriyani for bulk orders, Parotta, Grill & barbeque, Tandoori, Arabic mandi, Chinese, 100% halal, Dine-in, Delivery on Swiggy & Zomato.

### Is everything halal?
Yes, 100%. Every branch, every dish, every day, since 2003.

### Do you take bulk or catering orders?
Yes: office lunches, weddings and birthday buckets. For over 20 boxes, call the HQ line a day ahead.

### What are your opening hours?
Monday to Friday 11 AM – 11 PM, Saturday 11 AM – midnight, Sunday 12 noon – 11 PM.

### How do I book a table or a bulk order at Ya Rahman Biriyani?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call the central line on +91 97908 57802.
